scope.causal_question: Does an outcome-learned, content-addressed scalar slow-W field cause later fresh behavior beyond equal-information and equal-compute alternatives, and is the effect removed by exact base rollback or within-stratum shuffle and recovered by exact restoration?
scope.claim_boundary: This contract can identify a scalar causal shadow of semantic weight. It cannot establish the proposed relation tensor, incidence transport, role-aware operator, topology rewiring, agent transfer, consolidation, or a larger-AI claim.

weight_planes.semantics: volatile query-relative bond potential recomputed for each query
catalogue-level boost-only fast channel kept distinct from query_gate and learned efficacy
weight_planes.learning: no causal runtime is frozen in this contract

weight_planes.semantics: durable scalar macro-synaptic salience stored in immutable snapshots
proposed outcome-learned fast component of operator-valued semantic W
weight_planes.learning: target equation only; no production snapshot or causal runtime is implemented

formulae.removed: W_removed=W0 exactly, never an all-zero synthetic field
formulae.shuffled: W_shuffled=W0 plus P_stratum(DeltaW), with a forced derangement inside frozen relation-role-degree strata
formulae.restored: W_restored is the exact W_full snapshot SHA, not a relearned approximation
formulae.routing_actuation: A_W=macro_mean JSD(pi_full || pi_intervention)/ln(2); routing change is necessary but not sufficient for utility

intervention_invariants: W_REMOVED_BASE mounts the exact W0 snapshot rather than setting every ell to zero
W_RESTORED_EXACT mounts the bit-identical W1 snapshot and exact pre-LLM route digest
shuffle preserves the DeltaW multiset inside every frozen relation-role-degree stratum
shuffle preserves DeltaW L1 and L2 norms, support count, tensor shape, type, arity, and degree strata
all arms preserve topology, model, prompt protocol, embedding revision, relation schema, tasks, and candidate universe
stable edge-id renaming cannot change aggregate metrics
unordered role permutations are invariant and ordered role permutations are only equivariant
adding one constant to all local route logits cannot change local route probabilities
query_gate and boost_channel cannot be relabeled as outcome-learned W
eligibility is sealed before outcome and the answer is sealed before gold reveal
training answers, verdicts, rationales, and natural-language lessons never become W update state or later prompt input
world, relation, and component clusters are macro-aggregated before paired resampling
FULL and RESTORED numeric logits, ranks, route probabilities, and route digest must match before any LLM call

baseline_selection.rule: Choose one strongest baseline on development only, freeze its artifact SHA before sealed evaluation, and never select per sealed result.
